reasons.detail: For q4, form A's mutated prose condition also selects review-open-plan while form B has no matching row. The frozen q4 options and actual oracle omitted A's actual outcome, so the two forms did not contain behaviorally equivalent defect sets.

The B review harness reported an unrelated collector-loader error because validator.mjs referenced hashFile without importing it. Reviewers correctly avoided attributing it to the artifact, but a frozen review input was still defective.
The required coordinator-owned terminal transcript was not retained for both Codex B cells, so four auditable probe opportunities cannot be established.

non_gate_signal.observation: All four B reviewers independently reported D1, D2, and D4 but omitted D3 and D5.
non_gate_signal.interpretation: Table precedence and exact format-field completeness lacked sufficiently independent, machine-checkable witnesses. This is treated as a product-redesign input, not as a valid v2 score.

next_action: Strengthen general contract witnesses and diagnostics, freeze an equivalent v3 protocol, and rerun with fresh blind reviewers.
